terra.problem: The text does not say the rider is not carrying a basket.
The cookie-drawer joke makes light of the sword in a scene about people killing one another.
The claim that praise is all over Revelation refers to other passages without a reference.
Identifying Wormwood as a star gives away a detail from later in Revelation.
Saying a song sounds more exciting assumes the baker's reaction and treats the souls' rest as a matter of entertainment in a scene about their deaths.
The passage does not say the sun fails to stand still; it says the sun becomes black like sackcloth.
Calling it a night sky adds a time of day the text does not give.
Saying the sun and moon change in the same moment adds timing the text does not specify.
Saying a scroll is rolled up until it is gone adds disappearance to the text's comparison; a rolled-up scroll does not disappear.
John does not say he saw a scroll. He says the sky receded like one being rolled up.
Saying the people go low adds a direction the text does not give. They hide in caves and among mountain rocks.
Saying the question shows the people know they cannot withstand the day states their knowledge as fact. The text gives their question, not that explanation of what they know.
